input: Great bar for college students. Affordable drinks and they have projectors to watch games. Only drawback is the screen should be wider to avoid the picture going off into the wall. Spacious during the day, probably gets crowded at night.
Refine this for me please: This bar is an excellent choice for college students, offering affordable drinks and the added benefit of projectors for watching games. The only minor drawback is that the screen should be wider to prevent the picture from extending onto the wall. During the day, the bar provides ample space, but it may get a bit crowded in the evenings.

input: I had a terrible experience with this restaurant. I called in an order for a half sausage, half cheese pizza and the staff seemed to have no idea what I was saying. I had to constantly repeat myself and even had my boyfriend call back to confirm our order. Despite this, they still got it wrong and gave us an all sausage pizza instead. This is the second time in a month that I have received terrible service from them. I also had a previous incident where they forgot to put my order in when I arrived for pickup. Overall, it was a terrible experience.
Refine this for me please: I had an extremely disappointing experience at this restaurant. When I called to place an order for a half sausage, half cheese pizza, the staff appeared to be completely unaware of my request. I found myself repeating my order multiple times and even had to resort to having my boyfriend call back to ensure they got it right. Despite our efforts, they still managed to make a mistake and served us an all sausage pizza instead. This incident marks the second time within a month that I have encountered such poor service from this establishment. To make matters worse, there was a previous occasion where they failed to even process my order when I arrived for pickup. Overall, this entire experience can only be described as terrible.

input: Awful experience at Marmont Steakhouse. Cold soup, tasteless calamari, and wrong entree. Waiters argued with us about the mistake and caused illness from beef ravioli. Unapologetic staff. Avoid this place.
Refine this for me please: My experience at Marmont Steakhouse was extremely disappointing. Not only was the soup served to me cold, but the calamari lacked any flavor at all. To make matters worse, I received the wrong entree altogether. When we brought this to the attention of the waiters, they engaged in an argument instead of trying to rectify the mistake. As a result of consuming their undercooked beef ravioli, I fell ill afterwards. The staff's complete lack of apology or remorse for the entire situation only added insult to injury. I strongly advise avoiding this place at all costs.

input: Tako is the best place for sushi. Fresh and delicious, with private rooms for a fun night out. Must-try dishes like jalapeño yellowtail, kani salad, bird's nest roll, and naruto. Ordering is a breeze, and prices are reasonable - rarely spend over $35. Highly recommend Tako!
Refine this for me please: Tako is the ultimate destination for sushi lovers. Known for its extraordinary freshness and delightful taste, this restaurant offers the perfect setting for a memorable night out with its private rooms. Among their must-try dishes are the mouthwatering jalapeño yellowtail, refreshing kani salad, exquisite bird's nest roll, and tantalizing naruto. Additionally, ordering at Tako is effortlessly easy, and the reasonable prices ensure that you rarely spend over $35. With all these enticing qualities, I highly recommend Tako as the top spot for sushi enthusiasts.

input: The local ice cream is top-notch with flavors like Expresso Chip, Moose Tracks, and Graham Slam, all uniquely crafted and delicious.
Refine this for me please: The local ice cream is simply outstanding, offering an impressive selection of flavors such as Espresso Chip, Moose Tracks, and Graham Slam. Each flavor is meticulously crafted and boasts a distinctive, delectable taste.

input: We have been loyal customers at this car wash for years and have no complaints. Wednesdays are great for ladies as they offer a discount on all wash options. The $5 car wash is not hand-wash, but it's perfect for a quick bath. They occasionally run a 2 for 1 special on auto detail packages, which we always take advantage of because they consistently deliver great results.
Refine this for me please: As long-standing customers of this car wash, we are extremely satisfied and have never encountered any issues. Wednesdays prove to be especially beneficial for ladies as they provide a discount on all wash options. Although the $5 car wash is not done by hand, it offers a convenient and efficient option for a swift cleaning. Moreover, we often capitalize on their occasional 2 for 1 deal on auto detail packages, as they consistently deliver exceptional results.

input: This place is mediocre overall. The food is average, neither impressive nor terrible. The service can be hit or miss, depending on luck. Tried the drunken noodles and Thai green curry, but both were just average.
Refine this for me please: This place is generally mediocre. The food falls within an average range, lacking any remarkable qualities. The service is inconsistent, with outcomes largely dependent on chance. Specifically, I sampled their drunken noodles and Thai green curry which, unfortunately, were both unremarkable and average in taste.

input: Redemption at an old church is an extraordinary dining experience. The beautiful setting adds to the charm, especially for architecture enthusiasts. The service was impeccable, providing a fun time for our group. The paneed smoked soft shell crab was heavenly, and the seafood stuffed filet of fish was superb, enhancing the flounder's flavors. This meal ranks among the top 10 in my life. If you haven't been, you must try it!
Refine this for me please: Refined version: Redemption, located in an old church, offers an unparalleled dining experience that surpasses expectations. The exquisite setting, particularly appealing to architecture enthusiasts, enhances the overall charm. The impeccable service ensures a delightful time for every guest in our group. Indulging in the paneed smoked soft shell crab is a truly heavenly experience, while the seafood stuffed filet of fish elevates the natural flavors of the flounder to perfection. Undoubtedly, this meal is undeniably one of the top 10 dining experiences of my life. If you haven't had the pleasure, do not miss the opportunity to try it!

input: I love this place! Conveniently located near my home, I visit every other week. They regularly change flavors and have hidden toppings. The intense EDM music playing adds to the unique experience. Awesome!
Refine this for me please: I absolutely adore this place! It is perfectly situated close to my home, which makes it so convenient for me to visit every other week. One of the things I truly appreciate about them is that they frequently switch up their flavors, keeping things exciting and fresh. Additionally, they have this delightful secret assortment of toppings that always surprises me. Oh, and let's not forget about the intense EDM music they play, which truly enhances the already unique experience. It's simply awesome!

input: Incredible experience! The Steak Tartare was the best I've ever had and the Caribbean Seafood Pepper Pot and Curried Goat were absolutely wonderful. The unique combination of sweet curry and gnocchi in the goat dish was a pleasant surprise. Even with just a bite, the lime cheesecake was top notch. With no drinks due to post-Mardi Gras recovery, the service still stood out as exceptional. Great place, highly recommend!
Refine this for me please: The dining experience was truly remarkable! The Steak Tartare served to me was undeniably the best I've ever had. Additionally, I had the pleasure of savoring the exquisite flavors of the Caribbean Seafood Pepper Pot and Curried Goat, both of which were absolutely phenomenal. The goat dish, in particular, was a delightful surprise, with its unique combination of sweet curry and gnocchi. I couldn't resist trying the lime cheesecake and even with just a bite, it exceeded my expectations. Despite not indulging in any drinks due to my post-Mardi Gras recovery, the exceptional service truly stood out. I wholeheartedly recommend this outstanding establishment, as it is a must-visit for anyone seeking an extraordinary dining experience.

input: I went to this place on a Wednesday night. Despite being quiet, all tables were reserved except for the tall ones in the bar area. The location is not appealing, but the interior is stylish and masculine. The staff was knowledgeable and attentive, and the menu was intriguing. We ordered 3 small plates and a side dish, which was a bit too much for two people. The food was varied and unique, with reasonable prices. The smoked trout and venison hot dogs were fantastic, while the mini monte cristos were underwhelming. Overall, we paid $52.05 for the meal and left satisfied.
Refine this for me please:
On a Wednesday night, I visited a place that was relatively quiet but had all tables reserved except for the tall ones in the bar area. Although the location was not appealing, I found the interior to be stylish and masculine. The staff at the establishment was both knowledgeable and attentive, and the menu was intriguing.

Ordering three small plates and a side dish turned out to be a bit excessive for two people. However, the food itself was diverse and distinctive, and the prices were reasonable. Particularly enjoyable were the smoked trout and venison hot dogs, while the mini monte cristos were somewhat disappointing.

In the end, we paid a total of $52.05 for the meal and left feeling satisfied.

input: I had an amazing experience at this frozen yogurt place on South Street. The flavors were all delicious, even the fat-free options felt indulgent. Highly recommended if you're looking for a sweet treat while out and about.
Refine this for me please: I had an absolutely amazing experience at this incredible frozen yogurt place situated on South Street. Not only were the flavors absolutely mouthwatering, but even the fat-free options managed to feel incredibly indulgent. If you happen to be on the lookout for a delightful and sweet treat while you're out and about, I highly recommend giving this place a try.

input: I was impressed with the staff at this restaurant. Despite demanding customers and ridiculous complaints, our server, a small girl with purple hair, carried multiple plates, explained the menu flawlessly, and handled everything like a true professional. Thumbs up and five stars to the staff. As for the customers, they need to learn basic manners or stay home.
Refine this for me please: I was thoroughly impressed by the exceptional staff at this restaurant. Despite facing demanding customers and absurd complaints, our server, a remarkable small girl with vibrant purple hair, skillfully balanced multiple plates, flawlessly explained the menu, and conducted herself with utmost professionalism. The staff definitely deserves a sincere thumbs up and a stellar five-star rating. On the other hand, the customers could greatly benefit from acquiring basic manners or simply remaining at home.

input: I had a positive shopping experience at Hallmark despite not making a purchase. Their prices were fair, warranties and certifications were impressive, and the staff was friendly and not pushy. If I hadn't found a different car, I would have likely bought from them. Recommended for local buyers.
Refine this for me please: I had an exceptionally positive shopping experience at Hallmark, even though I ultimately didn't make a purchase. The prices they offered were fair and reasonable, and I was thoroughly impressed by the extensive warranties and certifications they provided. Moreover, the staff was extremely friendly and accommodating, never employing any pushy sales tactics. If it weren't for the fact that I found a different car elsewhere, I would most likely have chosen to buy from them. I highly recommend Hallmark, particularly for local buyers.

input: The white meat fried chicken was slimy and salty, while the sides (Mac and cheese and garlic mashed potatoes) were cold and flavorless. The service was strange, as the server laughed awkwardly during our order, making us feel uncomfortable. Won't return.
Refine this for me please: The fried chicken, which was supposed to be white meat, had a slimy and overly salty texture. Likewise, the sides - Mac and cheese and garlic mashed potatoes - were disappointingly cold and lacked any noticeable flavor. Adding to our dissatisfaction, the service was peculiar, with our server frequently laughing in an uncomfortable manner while taking our order. Overall, this experience left us feeling uneasy and we will not be returning to this establishment.

input: Fantastic lobster rolls, both warm and cold. The bread was fantastic too! Though slightly pricey, the quality of the food made it worth it.
Refine this for me please: The lobster rolls, both warm and cold, were absolutely fantastic. Additionally, the bread served with them was beyond delicious. While the prices were slightly high, the remarkable quality of the food definitely justified it.

input: The Habit Burger is a fantastic burger joint that stands toe-to-toe with In-N-Out. I had the double char and choco shake at the Goleta location, and as always, it was delicious. Don't miss out on their excellent onion rings too.
Refine this for me please: The Habit Burger is an exceptional burger restaurant that rivals In-N-Out. I recently tried their double char and choco shake at the Goleta location, and, as expected, it was absolutely mouthwatering. Make sure not to overlook their outstanding onion rings as well.

input: My husband and I have been regulars at this place for the past 8 years. The food is amazing, prepared quickly, and they offer fantastic drink specials.
Refine this for me please: My husband and I have been loyal customers at this establishment for a remarkable span of 8 years. The high-quality food served here never fails to amaze us, consistently prepared in a swift manner. Additionally, the establishment offers outstanding drink specials that further enhance our overall dining experience.

input: This is a typical Broad Ripple charming spot with a small, trendy, and bustling atmosphere. Unfortunately, they do not take reservations, which can be annoying for those traveling from another part of town. However, the cocktails were creative and delicious, and the server's suggestions were on point. The guacamole was tasty, but came with nuts despite requesting them to be left off. The Harvest salad was a highlight with its delightful combination of fruit and root vegetables. The Veracruz Trigger fish and Serrano Scallops were both delicious, accompanied by interesting white sweet mashed potatoes. The Tostones were a bit dry, but dipped in the Stewed Black Beans, they tasted great. Unfortunately, there were no gluten-free, dairy-free dessert options available. Overall, it's worth a visit, just make sure to arrive before 7 pm on a Friday to secure a table.
Refine this for me please: This is a charming spot in Broad Ripple, known for its small, trendy, and bustling atmosphere. It's important to note that they do not accept reservations, which can be inconvenient for those traveling from other parts of town. However, their cocktails are incredibly creative and delicious, and the server's recommendations were spot on. One downside was that the guacamole came with nuts, despite requesting them to be excluded. On the positive side, the Harvest salad was a standout dish, with its delightful combination of fruit and root vegetables. The Veracruz Trigger fish and Serrano Scallops were both delicious, and they were served with interesting white sweet mashed potatoes. The Tostones were a bit dry, but when dipped in the Stewed Black Beans, they tasted great. Unfortunately, there were no options for gluten-free or dairy-free desserts available. Overall, this place is definitely worth a visit, but be sure to arrive before 7 pm on a Friday to secure a table.

input: I've been to Jackson's multiple times and finally decided to leave a review. The panini Reuben was delicious with great use of garlic and perfectly sliced meat. However, the salad came out at the same time as the sandwich, which was not ideal, and the presentation was a bit sloppy. The sandwich was served directly on a plate instead of a napkin, causing the bread to get soggy if it sits for too long. The price is a bit high, but the food and drink quality justifies it. They have a great selection of wines and beers to choose from. The wait staff is generally friendly but can sometimes be short or distracted. The wait time for drinks can vary, with my longest wait being 15 minutes during a lunch rush. Overall, it was a good experience and I will return.
Refine this for me please:
I have been to Jackson's multiple times and have finally decided to leave a review. Firstly, I must commend the delicious panini Reuben which had a wonderful use of garlic and perfectly sliced meat. However, there were a few drawbacks to my experience. The salad arrived at the same time as the sandwich, which was not ideal, and the presentation of the dish was a bit sloppy. Instead of being served on a napkin, the sandwich was directly placed on a plate, causing the bread to become soggy if left for too long.

In terms of pricing, I found it to be a bit high. However, the quality of the food and drinks justified the cost. They offer an impressive selection of wines and beers, which is definitely a plus. The wait staff, on the whole, is friendly, although at times they can be somewhat short or distracted. Additionally, the wait time for drinks can vary, with my longest wait being 15 minutes during a busy lunch rush.

Despite these minor issues, I had a generally good experience at Jackson's and I would definitely consider returning.

input: Overall, I had a positive experience with Young who did my pedicure. She was friendly, had a positive attitude, and provided thorough massaging. However, I was disappointed with the gel manicure done by the owner. The old gel polish was not fully removed, the polish application was uneven with noticeable bumps, and the sides of my nails were not fully covered. This experience has made me reconsider returning to the salon.
Refine this for me please: In general, my encounter with Young during the pedicure was pleasant. She exhibited a friendly demeanor, a positive attitude, and gave an extensive massage. However, I was unfortunately dissatisfied with the gel manicure provided by the owner. The previous gel polish was not completely eradicated, resulting in an uneven application with noticeable bumps. Moreover, the sides of my nails were inadequately coated. This subpar experience has prompted me to reconsider patronizing the salon again.

input: I tried their amazing trio appetizer and the pizza was equally delicious. Overall, highly recommended.
Refine this for me please: I highly recommend their amazing trio appetizer and equally delicious pizza. Overall, it was a fantastic dining experience.

input: Hidden gem on the Westside with great food at a reasonable price. Must try the Indian taco and sweet fry bread. Daily specials like $1 tacos on Tuesdays and Fridays. I'm a regular, eating here at least once a week. Highly recommend.
Refine this for me please: Hidden gem on the Westside, this place offers delicious food at an affordable price. You must try their Indian taco and sweet fry bread, which are truly delightful. Additionally, they have tempting daily specials such as $1 tacos every Tuesday and Friday. As a regular patron, I visit this place religiously at least once a week and highly recommend it to all food enthusiasts.

input: The bakery not only offers delightful cookies, cupcakes, and puddings but also exceptional salted caramel cakes. The four-layered moist cake with caramel buttercream was truly amazing. I ensured the icing was made with real ingredients and it did not disappoint - the rich taste of butter and sugar was evident. The cake was both elegant and delicious, a rare combination.
Refine this for me please: The bakery not only offers an array of delightful treats including cookies, cupcakes, and puddings, but also stands out for its exceptional salted caramel cakes. One of their specialties is a four-layered, moist cake with a luscious caramel buttercream filling that can only be described as truly amazing. The bakery prides itself on using only real and high-quality ingredients, and their icing is no exception. It did not disappoint, as the rich flavors of butter and sugar were evident in every bite. The cake itself was not only delicious but also exuded an elegant charm, making it a rare gem in the world of confectionery.

input: Highly recommend skipping fancy desserts for a stroll around Broadway to visit this place. Their homemade ice cream, especially Cake Mix, is absolutely delicious. Perfect spot to end a date.
Refine this for me please: I highly suggest bypassing indulgent desserts in favor of taking a leisurely walk around Broadway to visit this remarkable place. Their homemade ice cream, particularly the mouthwatering Cake Mix flavor, is exceptional and a must-try. Trust me, it's the ideal spot to conclude a memorable date.

input: I stumbled upon this hidden gem of a sushi place and it was a game-changer. I used to overlook it for fast food chains, but no more. I had the delicious sushiya roll and it exceeded my expectations. The salmon was incredibly fresh and the miso soup was just perfect. I highly recommend this spot, it deserves a perfect 10/10 rating.
Refine this for me please: I came across this hidden gem of a sushi place and it completely transformed my dining experience. Despite previously neglecting it in favor of fast food chains, I have now changed my perspective. I indulged in the mouthwatering sushiya roll, and it was beyond exceptional. The salmon was remarkably fresh, and the miso soup was flawlessly prepared. I wholeheartedly suggest visiting this spot, as it truly deserves nothing less than a flawless 10/10 rating.

input: The best Thai food in the area! Wish I lived closer. Red curry, pad thai, and chicken satay with peanut sauce are amazing! Great lunch specials.
Refine this for me please: Experience the unrivaled Thai culinary delights in our area! If only I were fortunate enough to be a local resident. Indulge in the exquisite flavors of our red curry, pad thai, and succulent chicken satay complemented by a delectable peanut sauce. Additionally, our lunch specials are truly exceptional.

input: I took my family and daughter to this place for the first time. There were plenty of activities for my daughter and she loved it! However, I can only give it 2 stars because it was filthy. Despite the high admission price, the cleanliness was lacking. Staff didn't clean anything, electrical cords were exposed, and dust was everywhere. I hope management addresses these issues.
Refine this for me please: I brought my family, including my daughter, to this place for the first time. While there were numerous activities that my daughter thoroughly enjoyed, I can only assign it 2 stars due to the subpar cleanliness. Despite the steep admission fee charged, the overall hygiene was lacking. There seemed to be negligence on the part of the staff as they disregarded cleaning tasks, electrical cords were left exposed, and dust was prevalent throughout the premises. It is my sincere hope that the management addresses these pressing concerns promptly.

input: Had a great experience as a walk-in at this clean location with friendly staff. Tammy did an amazing job on my eyebrows, and as a first-time guest, the service was free. They offer fantastic packages for various waxing services. Will definitely be returning!
Refine this for me please: I had a wonderful experience when I walked in to this clean location with its friendly staff. Tammy did an outstanding job on my eyebrows, and as a first-time guest, I received the service for free. Moreover, they have incredible packages available for a wide range of waxing services. I am already looking forward to my next visit and will definitely be returning!

input: Extremely disappointed with this restaurant. Sushi was poorly cut, rice lacked flavor, and the dynamite was overly salty with excessive mayo. Left most of the food untouched. Avoid this place at all costs.
Refine this for me please: I had a very unsatisfactory experience at this restaurant. The sushi had uneven cuts, the rice lacked any noticeable flavor, and the dynamite dish was overly salty and drowned in excessive mayo. Unfortunately, I couldn't bring myself to finish most of the food. It's best to steer clear of this place to avoid disappointment.

input: Terrible service, had to order from the front counter after waiting for 30 minutes. Lazy waitresses prioritizing socializing over attending to customers. Advised another family to order takeout instead of dining in. Avoid this place and opt for delivery instead.
Refine this for me please: Extremely poor service experience at this establishment. I was left with no choice but to personally approach the front counter for my order after an agonizing 30-minute wait. The waitresses appeared disinterested and more focused on socializing rather than attending to the needs of the customers. To my disbelief, I even found myself advising another family to opt for takeout instead of dining in. My advice would be to steer clear of this place and explore the option of delivery instead.

input: This place is hands down the best Caribbean food in town. The dishes were fresh, perfectly cooked, and not heavy. The stewed chicken and curried chicken were both excellent, and the plantains were the best I've ever had. The owner was attentive and made sure we were satisfied. Amazing prices and a BYOB policy make it even better. I will definitely return and recommend it to everyone. Trust the 5-star reviews, they're real.
Refine this for me please: Without a doubt, this place surpasses all others in town when it comes to Caribbean cuisine. The dishes are incredibly fresh, flawlessly cooked, and remarkably light. The stewed chicken and curried chicken were exceptional, and the plantains were truly unparalleled - the best I have ever tasted. Additionally, the owner's attentiveness ensured our utmost satisfaction. The icing on the cake is the remarkable affordability and the option to bring your own beverages. I am undeniably eager to revisit and wholeheartedly recommend it to everyone. Don't hesitate to trust the authenticity of the glowing 5-star reviews.

input: Momo's is a cool and upbeat place, great for groups or first dates. The tapas plates were delicious, especially the scallops. Portions were generous but ordering two at a time is recommended. The Greek salad's dressing was too sweet. The Spanish granacha wine was excellent and reasonably priced. The belly dancer was cute but the experience felt a bit awkward. Despite better Greek food options in town, Momo's is the go-to place for a fun night out. We'll definitely return.
Refine this for me please: Momo's is a trendy and lively establishment, perfect for social gatherings or romantic outings. The tapas offerings were delectable, with the scallops standing out as a particular highlight. The portions were substantial, although it is advisable to order two dishes at once. Unfortunately, the dressing of the Greek salad was overly sweet. On the bright side, the Spanish granacha wine was outstanding and reasonably priced. While the belly dancer added a cute touch to the ambiance, the overall experience felt slightly uncomfortable. Despite the availability of superior Greek cuisine options in the area, Momo's remains the top choice for an enjoyable night out. We are eager to return in the future.

input: I used to love this store in high school, but the service has gone downhill. The staff is stuck up, and one girl even scolded me for holding a book incorrectly. I haven't been back in three years and don't plan to return anytime soon.
Refine this for me please: In high school, I used to have a great affection for this store; however, over time, I have noticed a significant decline in the service quality. The staff has become rather aloof, and their behavior is quite off-putting. I vividly recall an incident where one of the employees scorned me simply for holding a book incorrectly. As a result of these unfortunate experiences, I have refrained from visiting the store for the past three years and have no intentions of doing so in the near future.

input: Standing in line and squeezing onto a wooden bench with strangers may not sound appealing, and the lack of heating or air conditioning may not be ideal, but trust me, it's worth it. The jazz show is incredibly fun and the venue itself is cool and legendary. Give it a try at least once, and I'm willing to bet that you'll keep coming back for more.
Refine this for me please: Despite the initial discomfort of waiting in line and sharing a wooden bench with unfamiliar faces, don't let that discourage you. The experience of attending a jazz show in this vibrant venue is undeniably enjoyable and the atmosphere is filled with a sense of awe. While the absence of heating or air conditioning might not be perfect, it adds to the venue's authentic and legendary charm. Don't miss out on this opportunity and give it a chance, even if only once. I'm confident that you'll find yourself craving for more.

input: Not worth the $5 fee. Confusing layout, boring self-guided tour. Save your money; visit the courthouse instead.
Refine this for me please: This experience is not worth the $5 fee due to its confusing layout and a self-guided tour that lacks excitement. I recommend saving your money and exploring the courthouse instead.

input: Simply the best! Don't miss out on this gem in St Louis, MO. The frozen custard here is unparalleled and will exceed all your expectations.
Refine this for me please: Experience the best frozen custard in St. Louis, MO at this hidden gem. Don't miss out on the opportunity to indulge in a treat that surpasses all expectations.

input: The ambiance wasn't up to par, but the service was nice and the food was decent. Might go back if I'm in the area and in the mood for sushi.
Refine this for me please: Despite the ambiance not meeting my expectations, the service provided was pleasant and the food was of decent quality. I may consider returning if I happen to be in the area and craving sushi.

input: The food at this place was simply outstanding! We sampled a variety of dishes including the crawfish beignet, seafood stuffed mushrooms, crab cakes, crab cake po boy, and seafood flatbread. Every single item was absolutely scrumptious.
Refine this for me please: The food at this place was truly exceptional! We had the pleasure of trying a diverse range of dishes, such as the delectable crawfish beignet, mouthwatering seafood stuffed mushrooms, delicious crab cakes, satisfying crab cake po boy, and delightful seafood flatbread. Each and every item was incredibly tasty and enjoyable.

input: This DQ lacks quality and is not recommended. The staff seems inexperienced and it's best to look for another location.
Refine this for me please: This particular DQ is disappointing in terms of quality and thus not recommended. The staff appears to lack experience, making it advisable to find an alternative location.

input: My husband and I love supporting local businesses when we travel to keep the real economy thriving. This shop offers a variety of locally made goods, from clothes to artwork and food items. The owner is friendly and we had a great experience. We highly recommend checking it out, we found unique items like a dragonfly wall sculpture and space age pens.
Refine this for me please: My husband and I have a strong affinity for supporting local businesses when we travel, as it helps to stimulate and sustain the real economy. During our recent trip, we came across this charming shop which showcases an impressive range of locally made goods, including clothing, artwork, and delectable food items. The owner of the store is exceptionally friendly, and our overall experience was truly delightful. We wholeheartedly recommend paying a visit to this establishment, as we discovered a plethora of distinctive items such as a captivating dragonfly wall sculpture and futuristic space age pens.

input: I am incredibly impressed with this coffee shop in Reno. As coffee enthusiasts from Sacramento, my husband and I expected nothing but excellence, and we found it here. This place is an absolute gem that we wish existed back in Sac. It has become our go-to coffee shop, without a doubt. Their Matcha lattes are simply amazing. Sigh.
Refine this for me please: I am thoroughly impressed with this coffee shop in Reno. As avid coffee enthusiasts from Sacramento, my husband and I had high expectations and were not disappointed. This place is a true gem that we wish was in our hometown. We have unquestionably made it our regular coffee spot. Their Matcha lattes are absolutely amazing, leaving us in complete awe.

input: I recently moved to Idaho and had an amazing experience at Chipotle. Taylor, one of the staff members, comped one of my meals, making my week and day. Her exceptional customer service and friendly nature stood out among the rest. Taylor is absolutely awesome!
Refine this for me please: I had an incredible experience at Chipotle after recently moving to Idaho. Taylor, one of their staff members, went above and beyond by comping one of my meals. This unexpected gesture truly made my week and day. Taylor's exceptional customer service and friendly nature stood out among the rest of the staff. It is safe to say that Taylor is absolutely awesome!

input: This place is a martinis lover's paradise, offering an extensive selection of about 500 martinis. Don't miss out on their amazing giant pitchers of Petron Pomegranate Margaritas. Prices are fair, service is excellent, but be patient as the staff can be overwhelmed with their busy schedule. Don't hesitate to visit!
Refine this for me please: Refined version: This place is a true paradise for martini enthusiasts, boasting a vast collection of approximately 500 martinis for your selection. Be sure not to overlook their spectacular giant pitchers of Petron Pomegranate Margaritas. With reasonable prices and superb service, the only downside is the occasional delay due to the staff being occupied with their hectic schedule. Nonetheless, don't hesitate to pay them a visit as it's worth it!

input: Claudio's is the go-to place for any Italian food products. Their old-school, family-oriented atmosphere is worth standing in line for. They have exceptional cheeses and a deep knowledge of food. They are eager to help and so are the other customers. Hanging at Claudio's makes you want to be Italian. It's not just shopping, it's an experience everyone should have.
Refine this for me please: Claudio's is the ultimate destination for authentic Italian food products. Step inside and you'll be transported to a charming, old-school Italian atmosphere that exudes a warm, family-oriented vibe. The exceptional variety of cheeses and expansive knowledge of food they offer are unrivaled. Not only are the staff enthusiastic and ready to assist, but the fellow customers also contribute to the welcoming atmosphere. A visit to Claudio's is not a mere shopping trip, but an immersive experience that will leave you yearning to embrace your inner Italian. It is an encounter that should be on everyone's to-do list.

input: This hotel was terrible due to four main factors. Firstly, the prices were exorbitantly high, including charges for shuttle rides and overpriced amenities. Secondly, the service was extremely poor, with long hold times, wait times at the front desk, and unhelpful staff. Thirdly, despite being labeled as a resort, it was actually a loud convention hotel with constant noise and thin walls. Lastly, the hotel was excessively large, causing difficulties in finding one's way around and limited dining options. Overall, I'm relieved I attended a convention rather than paying for this disappointing hotel myself.
Refine this for me please: This hotel was an incredibly disappointing experience, marred by four significant factors. To begin with, the prices were truly exorbitant, with additional charges for shuttle rides and overpriced amenities. Furthermore, the level of service provided was shockingly poor, characterized by excessively long hold and wait times, along with unhelpful staff members. Adding to the dismay, despite being marketed as a resort, the reality was that it functioned as a noisy convention hotel, constantly plagued by disruptive noises and thin walls. Lastly, the sheer size of the hotel proved to be a major inconvenience, making it difficult to navigate and limiting dining options. When reflecting on my overall experience, I am genuinely relieved that I attended a convention and did not bear the financial burden of staying at this dreadful hotel.

input: I had high hopes for this place, but I was ultimately disappointed. The Dan Dan noodles were flavorful but lacked protein. The scallion pancakes were mediocre compared to another place I recently tried. The Wontons in Chilli oil were extremely spicy and lacked substance. The Talapia Medallions were fried well, but the greens were difficult to chew. The service and atmosphere were good, but I won't be going out of my way to eat here again. It feels too commercialized and Americanized for my taste. I prefer authentic Cantonese-style and hole-in-the-wall places.
Refine this for me please: Despite my high expectations, this place ultimately let me down. While the Dan Dan noodles had great flavor, they were lacking in protein. Compared to another recent experience, the scallion pancakes were average at best. The Wontons in Chilli oil were overly spicy and lacked depth. Although the Talapia Medallions were nicely fried, the greens were tough and difficult to chew. While the service and atmosphere were satisfactory, I won't make an effort to return here. The place feels too commercialized and Americanized for my taste. I prefer authentic Cantonese-style eateries and hole-in-the-wall spots.

input: This review highlights the frustration and disappointment the reviewer experienced with their stay at Hyatt. The reviewer questions whether Hyatt will ever grasp the importance of this issue, potentially risking another emergency room visit. Additionally, the high nightly parking fee of $29 in St. Louis is regarded as absurd. The repeated apology from the staff becomes tiresome for the reviewer.
Refine this for me please: This review highlights the reviewer's extreme frustration and disappointment with their stay at Hyatt. input: Visited this place on a busy weekend, had to wait over an hour - not worth it. Came back earlier and had a great experience. Pancakes are amazing, especially the butter pecan. They also offer turkey sausage and bacon. Highly recommend going early and wearing loose pants.
Refine this for me please: I had initially visited this place on a busy weekend and had to endure a wait of over an hour, which ultimately made the experience not worth it. However, upon returning at an earlier time, I had a truly fantastic experience. The pancakes, particularly the butter pecan ones, were nothing short of amazing. It's worth noting that they also serve delectable turkey sausage and bacon. I highly recommend arriving early and opting for loose-fitting pants to fully enjoy this place.

input: The food was average, disappointing for fried green tomato experts. Meatloaf was good but the sides were just average. Entertainment was also disappointing with limited songs played per hour.

input: Tina provided excellent service with quick attention, even on a Sunday morning. The wait time was minimal, approximately 15 minutes. The standout dish was the huevos bruncheros, an absolute must-try. It's hard to put into words how delicious it was, simply give it a taste yourself!
Refine this for me please: Tina delivered outstanding service with prompt attention, even on a Sunday morning. The minimal wait time of approximately 15 minutes was impressive. Among the remarkable dishes, the huevos bruncheros stood out as an absolute must-try. Words fail to capture the delectable taste, so it is highly recommended to experience it firsthand!

input: This place is the greatest! They have everything you need at great prices. The staff, though there may be a language barrier, is friendly and helpful. Highly recommended for computer item needs.

input: I loved the Clue game theme at this hotel! The staff, including bell boys, valet drivers, and bartenders, were all respectful and provided great service. Coming from California, we were impressed by the phenomenal service. However, it is worth being mindful of your spending as food at the hotel can be expensive. Refine this for me please: I had a fantastic experience at this hotel with its Clue game theme. The entire staff, from bell boys to valet drivers and bartenders, were incredibly respectful and provided excellent service. The phone etiquette was exceptional, and their customer service was outstanding. My girlfriend and I enjoyed our stay so much that we are already planning to return next year. The hotel's location in downtown Boise is perfect, although it can get a bit busy with traffic. Being from California, we were blown away by the amazing service we received. However, it's important to be mindful of your spending as the food at the hotel can be quite expensive. Additionally, one downside was the absence of air vents in the bathrooms, including ours. Despite this, our overall experience was great, but it would be wise to explore cheaper dining options nearby.

input: I tried the strawberry flavor at this Atlantic City location and it was amazing! It's not too sweet, but just perfect. I loved the added bits of strawberry in it. Refine this for me please: I had the opportunity to try the strawberry flavor at a fantastic Atlantic City location, and it was absolutely amazing! The sweetness level was just right, not overwhelming but perfectly balanced. The addition of real strawberry bits made the experience even more delightful. However, I assure you that I'll be returning to this spot without fail the next time I find myself in the lively Philly/AC area!

input: I had an amazing lunch yesterday! The staff was incredibly friendly and the portions were almost enough for two people. The recipes, passed down from Mrs. Doll, truly shine through with her son carrying on the legacy.

input: The Bridgeport Rib House offers tasty take-out options with fair prices. However, the bar service for pick-up orders falls short compared to other local barbecue establishments.

input: The recently revamped menu and increased prices at this place were disappointing. The food was mediocre, and as a beginner cook, I could tell it was not up to par. Refine this for me please: I was disappointed with the recently revamped menu and increased prices at this place. Additionally, the food seemed old and had a stale taste, almost as if it had been sitting out for weeks. Although the hostess was friendly, the incompetence of the waiter in serving wine was frustrating. In conclusion, despite their attempt to appear high-end, this restaurant is not worth the money. input: Excellent customer service! Brought in my watch for a battery change and they noticed a missing pin, which they fixed for free. Although the wait was a bit long, they were extremely friendly and didn't charge me for the battery. Highly recommended for purchasing jewelry.

input: This place offers the best of Jewish deli, Southern comfort, and Mexican cuisine. The brisket is flavorful, but don't expect a tomato-based sauce. I also highly recommend the Jewish Apple Cake - even after a few hours on a flight back to LA, it remained delicious, despite being a little overcooked on the bottom.
Refine this for me please: This establishment is a true culinary gem, seamlessly combining the finest Jewish deli, Southern comfort, and Mexican gastronomy. When it comes to their menu, prepare to be amazed. The brisket, in particular, is bursting with incredible flavor; however, it's important to note that it does not come with a tomato-based sauce. One dish that simply cannot be missed is their remarkable latke. A creative and delightful departure from the traditional round form, this version is both unique and absolutely delicious. Furthermore, I cannot stress enough how highly I recommend indulging in their Jewish Apple Cake. Even after enduring several hours on a return flight to LA, it managed to maintain its delectable taste, despite the slight overcooking on the bottom.

input: The food is average, but the main draw of this place is renting a karaoke room for big groups and bringing your own drinks. input: Overall, the staff at this dancewear store are friendly and attentive. They offer a range of quality products at reasonable prices. input: I highly recommend this place! I was referred here and it was a fantastic experience. I got my hair done in just five hours, with three women working on my medium-sized individuals. The cost was $150, including the hair. The staff was very nice, and I will definitely be returning.

input: The yum yum club is amazing, and their macaroni salad is awesome! While the service could be friendlier at times, I keep going back because the price is right and the food tastes great.

input: We tried this place for the first time last night and overall, it was a good experience. The service was a bit slow, possibly due to the busy Saturday night during March Madness. The complimentary homemade chips were fantastic, although they took longer to arrive than my husband's salad. The restaurant had a kid's movie playing on one of the nearby televisions, which kept my 3-year-old entertained. The food was great, with my burger and seasoned fries being wonderful. However, my husband's blackened chicken was a bit too spicy due to being over-seasoned. My daughter's macaroni and cheese looked delicious, but she couldn't resist eating the chips instead. The seating arrangement inside was a bit odd, with a table located close to the women's restroom door. Personally, I found it strange and ended up waiting until I got home to use the restroom. On a positive note, they offer a 15% military discount, which was much appreciated. Despite the slower service, I would still recommend this place, although I would have given it 5 stars if the service had been a bit better.

Our daughter's macaroni and cheese looked delicious, but unfortunately, she couldn't resist eating the chips instead. The seating arrangement inside was a bit odd, notably a table located close to the women's restroom door. Personally, I found it uncomfortable, leading me to wait until I got home to use the restroom. On a positive note, they offer a generous 15% military discount, which was much appreciated. Refine this for me please: I have been a dedicated patron of Cd Roma's for more than ten years, and I am thrilled with my experience there. The made-to-order Alfredo sauce is particularly heavenly, especially when paired with their breadsticks. Nevertheless, there is room for improvement in certain appetizers, namely the frozen cheesesticks and calamari. Despite this minor drawback, I still choose Cd Roma's over Olive Garden, even though I miss the cozy ambiance of the old location.

input: This is hands down my favorite sushi spot in Delaware. The menu is simple yet executed perfectly, with reasonably priced rolls that are bursting with fish. Although the service started off a bit slow, it gradually improved as the evening went on. The wings I ordered were absolutely delightful, although my boyfriend questioned whether they truly lived up to their advertised pound portion. Surprisingly, the gyro and fries exceeded my expectations, boasting exceptional flavors. Meanwhile, my boyfriend thoroughly enjoyed the French onion soup and potato skins. Our evening was made even more enjoyable by partaking in the exhilarating rock n roll bingo, a complimentary event hosted every Thursday. Additionally, this establishment offers entertainment amenities such as a pool table and darts in the back. With this memorable experience, we have no doubt that we will be returning in the future!

input: Johnny Tucci and his crew exceeded our expectations as videographers for our wedding. Their professionalism, punctuality, and extraordinary talent made our wedding footage resemble a cinematic masterpiece, leaving everyone who watched it in tears. Investing in a videographer is worth every penny, and Johnny and his team will not let you down.
Refine this for me please: Johnny Tucci and his crew surpassed all our expectations as videographers for our wedding. Their professionalism, punctuality, and exceptional talent transformed our wedding footage into an awe-inspiring cinematic masterpiece, bringing tears to everyone who witnessed it. Investing in a videographer is truly worthwhile, and you can trust Johnny and his team to deliver beyond your imagination.

input: Citizens Bank Park is one of the best places in the country to catch a ball game. The park offers plenty of interesting food and drink options, including a rooftop bar. The tickets are reasonably priced, especially compared to New York parks. There's not a bad seat in the house, but the outfield is a great option. The staff is helpful in recommending sections that avoid direct sunlight. Don't let the negative publicity about Philly fans deter you - the crowds are great and the park is well-policed. While you won't have the same sheltered experience as in your living room, it's still a fun atmosphere to enjoy a game with your family.
Refine this for me please: Citizens Bank Park stands out as one of the premier destinations nationwide for watching a baseball game. Apart from being visually appealing, the park offers an array of enticing food and beverage options, including the added attraction of a rooftop bar. What sets it apart even further is the affordability of its tickets, particularly when compared to its counterparts in New York. Furthermore, regardless of where you sit, every seat in the park provides a fantastic view, although the outfield seats are particularly noteworthy. In addition to this, the staff at Citizens Bank Park is extremely accommodating and readily offers guidance on sections that provide protection from direct sunlight. It is important not to be dissuaded by any negative preconceptions about Philadelphia fans, as the crowd atmosphere is delightful and the park is effectively policed. While attending a game may not offer the same level of comfort as watching from the confines of your living room, it does provide a vibrant and enjoyable atmosphere to share with your family.

input: I used to love Cosi, but lately, their signature salad has been consistently made wrong and they forgot the dressing. It is disappointing to see a decline in quality, especially considering their salad is the highlight of their menu. Quite frustrating.
Refine this for me please: I used to be a big fan of Cosi, particularly their signature salad, but recently, I have been consistently disappointed. The salad is consistently made incorrectly and they even forget to include the dressing. It's disheartening to witness such a decline in quality, especially since their salad is supposed to be the star of their menu. It's quite frustrating to say the least.

input: I had high hopes for Rembrandt's after its remodel, but was disappointed to find a modern and cold coffee shop instead of the beautiful, cozy old church I had imagined. The charm of Eagle is fading fast, and I urge people to talk to other shop owners in the area to preserve the town's quaintness and restore its beautiful buildings. So sad.
Refine this for me please: I was greatly anticipating the reopening of Rembrandt's following its remodel, only to be disheartened upon discovering a sterile and contemporary coffee shop in place of the enchanting and cozy old church I had envisioned. It's disheartening to witness the diminishing charm of Eagle, and I implore everyone to engage in conversations with other local shop owners to safeguard the town's quaintness and revive its remarkable architecture. It's truly disheartening.

input: Service lacking, poorly informed waitstaff, forgetful. Visually appealing but awkward and distasteful food. Stale waffles, rock-hard biscuits, fake chorizo. Atmosphere and alcohol selection are the only positives.
Refine this for me please: The service provided at this establishment is lacking, with poorly informed waitstaff who often forget important details. While the food may appear visually appealing, it disappoints with awkward and distasteful flavors. The waffles are stale, the biscuits excessively hard, and the chorizo lacks authenticity. On a positive note, the atmosphere is pleasant and the alcohol selection is commendable.

input: This restaurant offers a nice dining experience with a variety of menu options. The burgers are great, while the pizza can be slightly tough but still enjoyable, even the crust. The dining room area is very comfortable.
Refine this for me please: This restaurant provides an enjoyable dining experience with a diverse menu selection. The burgers are exceptional, while the pizza may sometimes be slightly tough yet still quite satisfying, including the crust. Additionally, the dining room area offers a high level of comfort.

input: This restaurant used to be great, but it has gone downhill. The bathrooms were dirty, the service was rude, and the food was disappointing. We won't be returning when there are better restaurants in the area.
Refine this for me please: This restaurant had a tremendous reputation in the past; however, it has regrettably declined in quality. The condition of the bathrooms was unsatisfactory, the service provided seemed discourteous, and the food failed to meet our expectations. Given the availability of superior dining options in the vicinity, we have decided against revisiting this establishment.

input: Decent bar/restaurant with typical menu options. Food quality was average, but the standout was the exceptional service.
Refine this for me please: A satisfactory bar/restaurant that offers a familiar menu selection. The overall food quality was decent, although not outstanding. However, the truly praiseworthy aspect of the experience was the exceptional level of service provided.

input: Highly recommended hidden gem! From the unassuming exterior, you wouldn't guess the incredible homemade comfort food inside. Flavorful BLT, generous with bacon and fresh veggies. Fries and coleslaw are top-notch. Don't miss out on their delicious pies. Will definitely be returning!
Refine this for me please: Hidden Gem Alert! This place comes highly recommended. Despite its unassuming exterior, prepare to be blown away by the mouthwatering homemade comfort food that awaits inside. Their flavorful BLT is a bacon lover's dream, piled high with crispy bacon strips and fresh, crispy veggies. The fries and coleslaw are truly top-notch, adding another layer of perfection to your meal. And whatever you do, don't leave without indulging in one of their delectable pies. Trust us, you'll be planning your return visit before you've even finished your last bite.

input: The staff was friendly and welcoming, and the food was served quickly. I enjoyed the chicken bacon croissant with chipotle sauce, which was delicious.
Refine this for me please: The staff at the establishment were incredibly friendly and welcoming, creating a pleasant atmosphere. Additionally, the food was served promptly, ensuring a prompt and satisfying dining experience. One dish that particularly stood out was the chicken bacon croissant with chipotle sauce, which was delightfully delicious.

input: This place offers excellent Thai food that surpasses the majority in Nashville. Despite the slightly outdated décor, the focus on the outstanding food makes it worthwhile.
Refine this for me please: This place exceeds the majority of Thai restaurants in Nashville with its exceptional cuisine. Although the décor may be slightly outdated, the emphasis on their outstanding food makes it a worthwhile dining experience.

input: This place is a must-visit for donut lovers! Even if you're not into sweets, their apple fritter and chocolate long john will change your mind. Skip other donut shops in St. Louis, this one is absolutely fantastic!
Refine this for me please: This place is a haven for donut enthusiasts and an absolute must-visit! Donut lovers will be delighted by a wide variety of irresistible treats. Even if you typically aren't drawn to sweets, the delectable apple fritter and luscious chocolate long john offered here will undoubtedly make you reconsider. When it comes to donut shops in St. Louis, don't waste your time anywhere else – this one is simply exceptional!

input: My favorite in New Orleans! Wonderful service, cozy ambiance. Get a reservation over the phone. Must try their lunch special spicy fried chicken. Corner booth by the window is the best table.
Refine this for me please: New Orleans' Finest: My absolute favorite! Exceptional service and cozy ambiance make it a top choice. Be sure to make a reservation by phone to secure a table. Don't miss out on their irresistible lunch special, the spicy fried chicken. For the ultimate experience, request the corner booth by the window – it's hands down the best seat in the house.

input: City Parkの近くにある激安かき氷屋さんは最高です！夏のニューオーリンズの暑さにはぴったりで、公園に行った後にここでかき氷を楽しむのがおすすめです。味の種類も50種類以上あり、トッピングをしても５ドル以下なのでとてもお得です。値段も安く、ぼくはたったの$1.50で満足できました。最高のチョイスです！
Refine this for me please: City Parkの近くにある激安かき氷屋さんは本当に最高です！ニューオーリンズの暑い夏にぴったりで、公園で遊んだ後にここでかき氷を楽しむのをおすすめします。味の種類も50種類以上あって、トッピングをしても5ドル以下なので、とてもお得です。値段も安く、私はたったの1.50ドルで満足できました。本当に最高の選択です！

input: Mr. X offers fantastic flavors with a friendly staff. Carry out wait time averages 20 minutes, much better than chain pizzerias at 45 minutes. The hand-tossed crust resembles traditional NY style pizza and delivers excellent flavor and texture.

Our commitment to prompt service is evident in our impressive average carry out wait time of only 20 minutes, leaving behind the lengthier intervals endured at chain pizzerias which typically reach 45 minutes. Our hand-tossed crust, akin to the illustrious and authentic New York style, exquisitely embodies a perfect balance of flavor and texture, resulting in a truly delightful culinary experience.

What's more, their prices are reasonable, making it an excellent choice for any budget. input: I highly recommend this place for brunch, dinner, or lunch take-out. The staff is consistently friendly and the food is always delicious.

To top it all off, the dessert was not only tasty but also satisfying. I left the restaurant feeling thoroughly impressed and eager to return on my next visit to town. Bravo to the entire team for a truly wonderful meal!

input: Avoid this place at all costs. The quality of the food is reminiscent of a mediocre small town Chi-Chi's. Save your time and money elsewhere.
Refine this for me please: I highly recommend avoiding this place completely due to its subpar food quality, which can be compared to that of a mediocre small town Chi-Chi's. It would be much wiser to invest your time and money elsewhere.

The bruschetta and salad were quite forgettable as well. While it may be a wonderful choice for memorable occasions, it might not be the best option if you prioritize outstanding food.

input: Highly recommend the staff at the dealership for their friendly service and constant communication during our recall fix on our 1999 Nissan Pathfinder. They treated us with the same attentiveness as someone purchasing a new car.
Refine this for me please: I highly recommend the dealership staff for their exceptional customer service and consistent communication throughout the recall repair process on our 1999 Nissan Pathfinder. input: This hole in the wall find is a hidden gem. From the vintage decor to the unassuming entrance, it surprises with its food. Not fancy or pretentious, just good. input: The festival may not sound appealing at first, but trust me, you're missing out on a fun weekend afternoon. The dance performances are breathtaking and I'll make sure to go every year. Not to mention, the quick service and detailed menus make ordering a breeze. Sharing the food with a group is highly recommended as it allows for sampling a variety of delicious options. input: Great taste in food, especially the brisket and cheese grits. However, repeated experiences of missing items in takeout orders have been disappointing. A minor drawback in an otherwise excellent restaurant.

input: Provi is an amazing person who drew me to this place. The chipotle chicken avocado sandwich and chicken noodle soup are delicious.

input: The Fountain is a great spot for a quick and affordable meal with a decent selection of sandwiches, salads, and soups. Their Cuban Sandwich and Royal Grilled Cheese were both excellent, with well-balanced flavors. The side of spicy carrots was unique and delicious. The service was fantastic and the food came out quickly. I can't wait to try more and give them a 5-star rating.

You can't go wrong with their outstanding Cuban Sandwich and Royal Grilled Cheese, which pack a perfect blend of flavors. The side of spicy carrots was an exciting surprise, adding a unique and delectable twist to the meal. The service provided was fantastic, and the food was promptly served. I'm eagerly looking forward to my next visit, as I'm excited to explore their other menu options and I'm certainly inclined to give them a well-deserved 5-star rating.

input: Burger Up is one of our favorite Nashville restaurants with a cool hipster vibe. The burgers are outstanding with endless options. Try the Woodstock with amazing Jack Daniels Maple Ketchup and delicious Benton's bacon. Don't miss the truffle fries! Vegetarians will love the troyathalon. The customer service is attentive and knowledgeable. Parking can be a bit challenging, but it's worth it. Definitely worth checking out!
Refine this for me please: Burger Up is a top-rated restaurant in Nashville, known for its trendy hipster atmosphere. The menu offers a wide range of burger options that are unparalleled in taste. If you visit, be sure to try the Woodstock burger, featuring a delectable combination of Jack Daniels Maple Ketchup and Benton's bacon. Additionally, the truffle fries are a must-have side dish. Even vegetarians won't be disappointed as they can enjoy the delightful troyathalon burger. The attentive and knowledgeable customer service adds to the overall dining experience. While parking might pose a slight challenge, the overall experience is definitely worth it. Make sure to pay a visit!

input: Overall, I have mixed feelings about this place. The wait time was much longer than expected, but the cheese fondue was delicious. The entree, however, wasn't impressive, especially the chicken and shrimp cooked in oil. The private booth provided a romantic and intimate setting. This place is recommended for those seeking privacy and have ample time to spare for a long dinner.

On the other hand, I thoroughly enjoyed the delicious cheese fondue. Unfortunately, the entree, particularly the chicken and shrimp cooked in oil, failed to meet my expectations. On a positive note, the private booth provided a romantic and intimate ambiance. Therefore, I would recommend this place to individuals seeking privacy and who can allocate enough time for a leisurely dinner.

input: Las Cazuelas is an excellent Mexican BYOB restaurant. The atmosphere is fun and festive, making it the ideal spot for a birthday celebration with friends. Las Cazuelas is an absolute must-visit for those seeking a memorable and enjoyable foodie adventure.

Refine this for me please: I had an extremely negative experience at this salon. In the past, I have personally witnessed bugs, which made me highly uncomfortable. During my recent visit, I decided to opt for a spray tan. However, I was extremely disappointed when I was given an outdated machine without a heater. Furthermore, the staff did not offer me any alternative or upgrade upon my arrival. What made matters worse was that while I left the salon, I noticed that the person in the superior versapro room was still receiving sprays. This made me feel like I was being treated unfairly and shortchanged. Moving forward, I have decided to take my business to Shine, where the quality of their rooms is consistently superior.

input: If you've never experienced Mongolian BBQ before, this is the spot! It's a unique and delicious dining experience where you can fill your bowl with a variety of ingredients, including meat, and then the chef works their magic. Don't forget to try their amazing sesame bread – I always get an extra piece! A must-try for sure.
Refine this for me please: This is the ultimate destination if you have never had the pleasure of indulging in Mongolian BBQ. Prepare yourself for a dining adventure like no other, as you get to curate your bowl with an array of tantalizing ingredients, including delectable meats. Witness the incredible artistry of the chef as they transform your chosen ingredients into a masterpiece before your eyes. And do not miss out on the sheer delight of their extraordinary sesame bread, so irresistible that I always seek an additional serving. Without a doubt, this is an absolute must-try experience.

input: Amazing Sno-balls with fantastic flavors, including all-natural options. Super friendly service. Can't wait to return!
Refine this for me please: Exquisite Sno-balls with an incredible array of flavors, featuring both delectable all-natural options. The customer service is exceptionally warm and friendly, leaving me eagerly anticipating my next visit.

input: We thoroughly enjoyed our meal at this restaurant. The General Tsao chicken was delicious and my wife loved her Curry Chicken. The portions and prices were reasonable, and the customer service was excellent. The limited seating was not an issue for us. We will definitely be returning in the future.
Refine this for me please: We had a fantastic dining experience at this restaurant. The General Tsao chicken was absolutely delicious, and my wife couldn't get enough of her Curry Chicken. The portions were generous and the prices were reasonable, making it a great value for money. Moreover, the customer service exceeded our expectations with their attentive and friendly demeanor. Despite the limited seating, it did not detract from our overall enjoyment. Needless to say, we will definitely be making a return visit to this restaurant in the future.

input: The food was exceptional, and the three-course meal was absolutely delicious! Our waiter Jenna was fantastic - she was knowledgeable, fun, and made our experience perfect. The staff made my birthday dinner an absolute delight for my taste buds.
Refine this for me please: The dining experience was exquisite with exceptional food and a delightful three-course meal. Our waiter, Jenna, was truly fantastic - she exhibited extensive knowledge, added a touch of fun, and contributed to making our experience absolutely perfect. The staff collectively made my birthday dinner an absolute delight, leaving a lasting impression on my taste buds.

input: Mellow Mushroom is hands down the best pizza place in the bay with a great beer selection. The Maui Wowie is our favorite, with the perfect crunchy crust. Friendly staff and no wait for a table.
Refine this for me please: In the bay area, Mellow Mushroom undoubtedly stands out as the premier pizza place, celebrated for its outstanding beer selection. Our top choice, the Maui Wowie, surpasses all others, featuring a flawless, crunchy crust that leaves you craving more. The staff is exceptionally friendly, and you can expect to be seated promptly without any waiting time.

input: Great food and attentive wait staff who are accommodating towards allergies. However, disappointing drink pours with watered-down bourbon detracted from overall dining experience.
Refine this for me please: The dining experience offered excellent food and attentive wait staff, who were also accommodating towards allergies. However, the disappointing drink pours, particularly the watered-down bourbon, detracted from the overall enjoyment of the meal.

input: The donuts are simply perfect - flawless dough and perfectly balanced icing.
Refine this for me please: The donuts are absolutely perfect, with flawless dough and a perfectly balanced icing.

input: We finally visited Taste of Havana and we are glad we did! The Pan con Bistec and Cuban sandwiches were amazing, we couldn't resist finishing them. The owner, Diana (or Dayana), was very friendly and shared her heartfelt story of opening the restaurant. We highly recommend trying their sandwiches and enjoying the inviting atmosphere. We are already excited for our next visit and planning to bring friends along. Thank you for a memorable evening!
Refine this for me please: We had an exceptional experience at Taste of Havana and we are thrilled that we decided to visit! The Pan con Bistec and Cuban sandwiches exceeded our expectations and left us wanting more. Diana (or Dayana), the owner, welcomed us with open arms and graciously shared the heartfelt story of her journey in opening the restaurant. We wholeheartedly recommend indulging in their sandwiches while soaking in the warm and inviting atmosphere. Already looking forward to our future visit, this time with friends in tow. Thank you for providing us with an unforgettable evening!

input: The Tiki Tolteca bar in New Orleans is a must-visit! The scorpion bowl, piña colada, fried shrimp taco, and Jell-O shots were all delicious. The bar mixer was friendly and the interior had a fun Tiki theme. Perfect for a group outing or a romantic date, this non-commercial establishment is small enough for an intimate atmosphere but big enough to have a good time. Highly recommended!
Refine this for me please: You must visit the Tiki Tolteca bar in New Orleans! Their scorpion bowl, piña colada, fried shrimp taco, and Jell-O shots are absolutely delicious. The friendly bar mixer and the fun Tiki-themed interior add to the overall experience. Whether you're planning a group outing or a romantic date, this small yet lively establishment offers an intimate atmosphere without sacrificing the ability to have a great time. I highly recommend checking it out!

input: Unfortunately, my experience at this restaurant was highly disappointing. Despite waiting for 40 minutes to be seated, the hot breakfast was served cold and the food was not prepared according to my requests. The sausage links were burnt even after sending them back, and the eggs were not cooked as over-medium. Additionally, I had to repeatedly ask for coffee refills, and the waitress appeared indifferent to the deficiencies in the service. To make matters worse, it took over 10 minutes to receive the check, giving me ample time to write and post this review. At a price of $40 for a simple breakfast for two, this experience was certainly not worth it.
Refine this for me please: Unfortunately, my experience at this restaurant was extremely disappointing. Despite enduring a 40-minute wait to be seated, the hot breakfast I finally received was served cold and did not meet my specific requests. Both the sausage links and the eggs were subpar, with the former being burnt even after replacement and the latter failing to be cooked over-medium as requested. On top of that, I had to repeatedly request coffee refills and the waitress showed indifference towards the various shortcomings in their service. To exacerbate matters, it took an excruciating 10-odd minutes to receive the check, leaving me with ample time to write and publish this review. Considering the steep price of $40 for a simple breakfast for two, this experience was undeniably substandard and far from being worth it.

input: I frequent Sukho Thai and I find the negative ratings unjustified. While it may not be the most authentic Thai place, the food and service are consistently good. Their red and green curry are excellent, and I appreciate how the owner personally attends to the tables. The location next to a go-cart track adds a quirky touch. My only complaint is the absence of my favorite dish, Kee Mao, which I usually go elsewhere for.
Refine this for me please: I am a regular customer at Sukho Thai and I strongly believe that the negative reviews it receives are unwarranted. Though it may not be the epitome of Thai authenticity, the restaurant consistently delivers delicious food and exceptional service. The red and green curry dishes in particular are outstanding, and I greatly admire the owner's hands-on approach in catering to the guests. Additionally, the unique proximity to a go-cart track adds an interesting and fun element to the dining experience. However, it is disappointing that they do not offer my favorite dish, Kee Mao, which prompts me to seek it elsewhere.

input: Muriel's offers a delightful dining experience with its stunning views, haunted history, and delicious food. Make sure to explore the 2nd level for a tour of the lounge area and enjoy a fantastic view of Jackson Square from the wrap-around balcony. The indoor patio dining area is my personal favorite for its tranquil setting. The dinner pre-fix menu is a great value, with the seafood gumbo and dijon mustard encrusted salmon being standout dishes. The wood grilled pork chop for lunch was flavorful and tender, although the accompanying red beans and rice were a bit bland. Overall, Muriel's is a must-visit for its ambiance and quality cuisine.
Refine this for me please:
Muriel's is an exceptional dining destination that offers a delightful experience, thanks to its breathtaking views, rich historical significance, and delectable cuisine. For an all-encompassing experience, make sure to explore the 2nd level, which boasts a captivating lounge area and a wrap-around balcony that provides a fantastic panorama of Jackson Square. Personally, I find the indoor patio dining area to be my favorite due to its serene atmosphere.

One of the major highlights at Muriel's is their dinner pre-fix menu, which offers great value for money. Among the standout dishes, the seafood gumbo and dijon mustard encrusted salmon truly impress with their bold flavors. For lunch, the wood grilled pork chop is a flavorful and tender choice, though the accompanying red beans and rice could benefit from a touch more seasoning.

All in all, Muriel's is an absolute must-visit for both its inviting ambiance and high-quality cuisine.

input: Had an amazing lunch of fried green tomatoes and vegan barq. Excellent food, great beer selection, and a fantastic vibe. Super friendly and attentive staff, with enjoyable tunes playing in the background. Will definitely be returning!
Refine this for me please: Had an incredible lunch today, indulging in perfectly fried green tomatoes and a refreshing vegan barq. The food was excellent and complemented by an impressive selection of beers. The atmosphere was absolutely fantastic, with enjoyable tunes playing in the background. The staff were exceptionally friendly and attentive, making the experience even more enjoyable. I am already planning on returning to this amazing place!

input: This Walmart in Meadowlark is conveniently located near my doctor's office. It's smaller than the supercentre but offers a decent selection of affordable items in the food section, although the produce section can be limited. Snacks and canned food are reasonably priced. Other sections and items can be hit or miss, like the limited selection of lightbulbs and lack of helpful associates. However, the checkout lines are usually short, which is a plus.
Refine this for me please: This Walmart in Meadowlark is conveniently located near my doctor's office. While it's smaller than the supercentre, it still offers a decent selection of affordable food items, although the produce section can be limited. The snacks and canned food are reasonably priced. However, other sections and items may vary in quality, such as the limited selection of lightbulbs and the lack of helpful associates. On the positive side, the checkout lines are usually short, which is a plus.

input: This yoga place has significantly higher costs compared to others without reasonable justification. The two-for-one session deal, seemingly generous, is quite limited as it must be used within 14 days. Inconveniently, the location is quite far from the busy highway.
Refine this for me please: This yoga studio unjustifiably charges considerably higher prices compared to other options. Additionally, their two-for-one session deal, which may appear generous, is unfortunately restricted to a mere 14-day validity. Inconveniently, the studio is located quite far from the bustling highway.
